card.name: Time-of-day words before clock times
card.fires_on: Words that name a part of the day or a schedule slot, such as morning, evening, Time:, or a weekday, right before a clock time or a meal is named. Seen in dosing instructions and event listings.

modes.label: Morning/evening meal
modes.description: The words morning or evening after 'the' and before 'meal' or 'and evening meals' in dosing directions.
modes.example: orally once daily with a glass of water, without food, at least 2 hours after the<< evening>> meal.

modes.label: Event time slots
modes.description: A day name or the word Time at the start of an event listing, where a clock time follows.
modes.example: Please join us: Date: Wednesday, December 7th <<Time>>: 4:00pm –

modes.label: Leaving by a time
modes.description: A verb of departure that is followed by a stated clock time.
modes.example: We have to<< leave>> by no later than 6:0

card.writes: It suppresses pm/am/clock tokens, so it makes a clock-time marker less likely right after.
card.plain: It fires on words like morning, evening or Time that set up a schedule, just before the actual hour would be given.
